title: Safe with repair and/or engineering monitoring for two cycles.
officialText:
The approved agency shall not file a report of a safe condition with repair and/or engineering monitoring program for the same parking structure for two consecutive filing periods unless the second such report is accompanied by his or her professional certification attesting to the correction of all conditions identified in the prior report as requiring repair.

(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 1/1/2022)
